lead: Shahbaz Ahmed is best known as a Pakistani field hockey player, born on 1 September 1968 in Faisalabad.
As of 2026, he is 57 years old, and his birth date places him under the Virgo sign.
He has held the office of Member of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and has been recognised with the Pride of Performance.
